readme:
# DPOK 高斯 KL 上界与策略梯度

## 1. 问题

计算逐步高斯 KL，并实现奖励 score 梯度与直接 KL 梯度的组合。

实现论文 Eq. (9) 的高效梯度近似；不声称包含 Eq. (8) 状态访问分布的完整导数。

## 2. 核心公式

$$
K_{bt}=\frac{\|\mu_{bt}-\mu^{ref}_{bt}\|^2}{2s_t^2},\quad L=\frac1B\sum_b[-\alpha\operatorname{sg}(r_b)\sum_t\ell_{bt}+\beta\sum_t K_{bt}].
$$

## 3. 公式到代码

```python
gaussian_kl(current: Tensor, reference: Tensor, std: Tensor) -> Tensor
```
```python
dpok_surrogate(logp: Tensor, rewards: Tensor, kl: Tensor, alpha: float, beta: float) -> Tensor
```

相同协方差的高斯 KL 化简为均值差的加权平方和。时间维求和对应轨迹 KL 上界；batch 维求均值。奖励乘当前 log 密度的 score 项，直接 KL 项保留梯度。

## 4. 本题约定

gaussian_kl: current/reference (B,T,D), shared std (T,)>0; return (B,T). dpok_surrogate: logp/kl (B,T), terminal rewards (B,), alpha>0, beta>=0; sum time and mean batch.

Current Gaussian means and KL penalties differentiate. Reference means, scales and terminal rewards are frozen; supplied logp differentiates. State-visitation gradients omitted as in Eq. (9).

## 5. 交互图与实验

实验使用你提交的函数。图中各点来自实际运行结果。

A Gaussian scalar policy with variance 1 learns a quadratic target under beta=0.4 KL to a zero-mean reference; 70 updates are compared against the analytic regularized optimum 2/(2+beta).

## 6. 在网页中运行

在右侧 Python 编辑器中补全实现，点击 **运行测试**。查看失败测试的原因、期望值与实际值，修改代码后再次运行。所有必要测试通过后，题目会标记为已完成并解锁坑点讲解。

## 7. 延伸

推导原论文附录 A.3 中被省略的状态分布梯度项。

[DPOK: Reinforcement Learning for Fine-tuning Text-to-Image Diffusion Models](https://arxiv.org/abs/2305.16381) · Section 4.1 Lemma 4.2 and Eqs. (7)-(9), efficient gradient approximation
notes:
# 题解与常见错误

相同协方差的高斯 KL 化简为均值差的加权平方和。时间维求和对应轨迹 KL 上界；batch 维求均值。奖励乘当前 log 密度的 score 项，直接 KL 项保留梯度。

$$
K_{bt}=\frac{\|\mu_{bt}-\mu^{ref}_{bt}\|^2}{2s_t^2},\quad L=\frac1B\sum_b[-\alpha\operatorname{sg}(r_b)\sum_t\ell_{bt}+\beta\sum_t K_{bt}].
$$

Current Gaussian means and KL penalties differentiate. Reference means, scales and terminal rewards are frozen; supplied logp differentiates. State-visitation gradients omitted as in Eq. (9).

KL 不是采样动作 log 比率的单次估计；它是闭式的分布距离。不要对时间求平均，也不要将 KL 一并 detach。

测试依据：标量 KL、时间重复线性缩放、解析奖励与正则梯度、零 KL 端点和在线有正则 bandit。

## 实验标定

固定种子 42，CPU float64，直接梯度下降；无需数据下载。以下是参考解实际测量，不是预设轨迹。 PyTorch 2.14.1. lr=.035 (70 updates).

```json
{"final_error": 0.00024093245881487226, "initial_error": 0.6944444444444445, "mean": 0.8178113341446054}
```

验收阈值见 `tests/test_core.py::test_real_toy_experiment`；基线为训练前参数的实际输出。

en.title: DPOK Gaussian KL Bound and Policy Gradient
en.readme:
# DPOK Gaussian KL Bound and Policy Gradient

## 1. Problem

Compute per-step Gaussian KL and combine reward score gradients with direct KL gradients.

Implement the efficient gradient approximation in Eq. (9), not the full state-visitation derivative of Eq. (8).

## 2. Core equations

$$
K_{bt}=\frac{\|\mu_{bt}-\mu^{ref}_{bt}\|^2}{2s_t^2},\quad L=\frac1B\sum_b[-\alpha\operatorname{sg}(r_b)\sum_t\ell_{bt}+\beta\sum_t K_{bt}].
$$

## 3. From equations to code

```python
gaussian_kl(current: Tensor, reference: Tensor, std: Tensor) -> Tensor
```
```python
dpok_surrogate(logp: Tensor, rewards: Tensor, kl: Tensor, alpha: float, beta: float) -> Tensor
```

Equal-covariance Gaussian KL reduces to a variance-weighted squared mean distance. Sum over time for the trajectory bound, average over samples, and combine the frozen-reward score term with differentiable KL.

## 4. Contract

gaussian_kl: current/reference (B,T,D), shared std (T,)>0; return (B,T). dpok_surrogate: logp/kl (B,T), terminal rewards (B,), alpha>0, beta>=0; sum time and mean batch.

Current Gaussian means and KL penalties differentiate. Reference means, scales and terminal rewards are frozen; supplied logp differentiates. State-visitation gradients omitted as in Eq. (9).

## 5. Visualization and experiment

The experiment calls your submitted functions; plotted points are measured results.

A Gaussian scalar policy with variance 1 learns a quadratic target under beta=0.4 KL to a zero-mean reference; 70 updates are compared against the analytic regularized optimum 2/(2+beta).

## 6. Run your implementation

Complete the functions in the Python editor on the right, then click **Run tests**. Inspect each failed check, update your implementation, and run again. Passing every required check marks the problem as solved and unlocks the notes.

## 7. Extensions

Derive the omitted state-visitation gradient term in Appendix A.3.

[DPOK: Reinforcement Learning for Fine-tuning Text-to-Image Diffusion Models](https://arxiv.org/abs/2305.16381) · Section 4.1 Lemma 4.2 and Eqs. (7)-(9), efficient gradient approximation
en.notes:
# Solution reasoning and pitfalls

Equal-covariance Gaussian KL reduces to a variance-weighted squared mean distance. Sum over time for the trajectory bound, average over samples, and combine the frozen-reward score term with differentiable KL.

$$
K_{bt}=\frac{\|\mu_{bt}-\mu^{ref}_{bt}\|^2}{2s_t^2},\quad L=\frac1B\sum_b[-\alpha\operatorname{sg}(r_b)\sum_t\ell_{bt}+\beta\sum_t K_{bt}].
$$

Current Gaussian means and KL penalties differentiate. Reference means, scales and terminal rewards are frozen; supplied logp differentiates. State-visitation gradients omitted as in Eq. (9).

The closed-form KL is a distributional distance, not a sampled log ratio. Do not average across time or detach the KL penalty.

Test basis: Scalar KL, linear scaling under timestep repetition, analytic reward/regularizer gradients, zero-KL endpoints and a regularized online bandit.

## Experiment calibration

Seed 42, CPU float64, direct gradient descent, no downloaded data. Values below were measured from the reference, not a preset trajectory. PyTorch 2.14.1. lr=.035 (70 updates).

```json
{"final_error": 0.00024093245881487226, "initial_error": 0.6944444444444445, "mean": 0.8178113341446054}
```

Acceptance thresholds are in `tests/test_core.py::test_real_toy_experiment`; the baseline is the measured output before training.
